title: Causal Inference in Natural Language Processing: Estimation, Prediction, Interpretation and Beyond
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not describe or use any benchmark that measures aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on causal inference in NLP.
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on the application of causal inference methods to Natural Language Processing.
